interface.name: ESA Indico public anonymous interface
interface.access_route: Anonymous HTTPS public search, export, timetable, note, and same-origin attachment routes only; no authentication, cookies, login, or private-object attempt.
interface.database_or_collection: ESA Indico public event, contribution, material, and public-note object routes
interface.timezone: Capture timestamps in UTC; preserve source object timezone fields without conversion.

executions.purpose: Bounded anonymous event, paired contribution/subcontribution, and attachment field/group probe.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET https://indico.esa.int/search/api/search?q=satellite&type=event; paired GET with type=contribution&type=subcontribution; GET with type=attachment.
executions.notes: Diagnostic prefixes only; no result was screened or imported.

executions.purpose: Bounded phrase, implicit-term, Boolean-word, symbolic, parenthesis, field-syntax, case, hyphen, finite/wildcard, and explicit-zero diagnostics.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: Anonymous GET query matrix at /search/api/search using event and normal paired contribution/subcontribution types; exact strings are retained in the safe query-matrix artifacts.
executions.notes: A zero in an individual query is recorded as the source response; this matrix is not a final search.

executions.purpose: Bounded paired-contribution and attachment cursor/ordering probe.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET q=satellite with paired contribution/subcontribution and attachment groups, first cursor, next cursor, and first-page repeat.
executions.notes: The test validates only the observed prefixes and does not establish full search-result completeness.

executions.purpose: Bounded root-category scope, count, interval, and repeat-order probe.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET /export/categ/0.json?from=2025-11-04&to=2025-11-06; comparison GET /export/categ/6.json over the same range; repeated GET /export/categ/0.json?from=2026-06-29&to=2026-07-03.
executions.notes: Range-local count reconciliation was observed, not whole-universe completeness.

executions.purpose: Bounded event/export/timetable child, identity, note, and relation probe.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET /export/event/571.json?detail=contributions; GET /export/event/644.json?detail=contributions; GET /export/event/293.json?detail=contributions; GET /event/293/timetable/ and selected note routes.
executions.notes: Count is three top-level event exports plus bounded child ledgers; it is not a candidate count.

executions.purpose: Bounded anonymous public PDF retrieval/parser and ZIP transport diagnostic.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET one public PDF attachment, technical PDF parse only, then discard bytes; HEAD and bounded GET-range probe of one public ZIP attachment.
executions.notes: No full archive traversal or candidate matching occurred.

executions.purpose: Bounded public route distinction between Indico and general ESA/publications/historical-archive pages.
executions.exact_query_or_operation: GET https://www.esa.int/esearch; GET ESA Publications listings; GET ESA Archives how-search-and-credit page.
executions.notes: These routes were inspected only to delimit ESA Indico; none was searched for review candidates.

checks.requirement: Pilot forbids screening and candidate import.
Identify public events, paired contributions/subcontributions, materials, and any relevant public object route.
checks.notes: Notes were identified as an additional public text route; bare categories/sessions are structural only in the draft.

checks.requirement: Test phrase, implicit terms, Boolean words, parentheses/symbolic forms, field syntax, and expansion behavior.
checks.notes: The observed behavior does not support lossless direct partitions.

checks.requirement: Inspect pagination, total=-1 semantics, identifiers, and bounded repeat ordering.
checks.notes: Search-prefix behavior was tested only diagnostically.

checks.requirement: Establish a reproducible complete public source-universe enumeration and completeness proof.
checks.notes: Root recursion, uncapped range coverage, undated objects, and full two-pass ledger remain unproved.

checks.requirement: Validate event, contribution, sub-contribution, note, and material child relationships.
checks.notes: Event/contribution/material/note samples were reconciled; a live sub-contribution and all-event traversal were not.

checks.requirement: Specify exact local P/E/M/G_model/G_structure/C1/R/T2/V1/O1 matching, tags, overlap accounting, and no cross-route combination.
checks.notes: The specification is deterministic but final execution remains blocked by C05/C06/C08.

checks.requirement: Validate attachment retrieval and define missing/inaccessible/unparseable treatment.
checks.notes: One PDF parsed; ZIP transport was probed; all attachment types/recursive parsing remain unvalidated.

checks.requirement: Define date precision/window and language handling without an unsupported native limit.
checks.notes: P-001 has not supplied the common cutoff; source language/date gaps are retained rather than filtered.

checks.requirement: Distinguish Indico from general ESA website, publications, and archive searches.
checks.notes: External route descriptions were read but not used for discovery.

checks.requirement: Inspect rate-limit behavior and define a safe failure/retry rule.
checks.notes: No 429/Retry-After ceiling was observed; the draft specifies a conservative future rule.

artifacts.role: evidence map and ignored-worklog checksum inventory

disposition.reason: The pilot independently confirmed that direct Boolean translation is lossy and identified a provisional public event/export/timetable/note/material traversal, but did not establish a complete root source universe, full child/note coverage, sub-contribution behavior, or all-material parsing coverage. A final local event would otherwise rely on hidden completeness assumptions.
human_verification_required: Decide and, if needed, commit the protocol/source-boundary treatment of public event_note objects before a final run.
Re-pilot and approve a root-category exhaustive partition/count/two-pass proof, including undated-event handling and cap testing.
Validate all-event timetable/note traversal and a live sub-contribution instance.
Validate recursive archive/non-PDF/link attachment handling, source rate limits, and full-run storage/rights procedure.
Set the P-001 common evidence cutoff before any final date handling.
